title: Mel Kiper’s mock draft focuses on premium positions for the Jets

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mel Kiper’s mock draft focuses on premium positions for the Jets
sources.description: ESPN’s Mel Kiper has released a new mock draft where he has the Jets using their two first round picks to address needs at the two most important positions on the field. In my January mock draft, I had Ohio State linebacker Arvell Reese here. In February, I went with Ohio State safety Caleb Downs. […]
